title: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.21439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance between the two next-token distributions measures each token's relevance and reassigns the advantage. translated_title: 各奖励归于其相关词元：面向多奖励强化学习的奖励专属词元级信用分配
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地在多个可验证奖励下同时训练，例如工具调用的正确性与格式，或复杂指令的各项约束条件。奖励解耦归一化（GDPO）对每个奖励分别进行归一化，使不同的奖励组合保持各自独立的优势，但它仍然将每个奖励的优势均匀地分散到整个响应上，而实际上每个验证器只检查少数几个位置。我们提出MRTPO，它利用每个验证器所检查的信息，将每个奖励的优势分配给与其相关的词元，且无需辅助模型或词元级标注。对于每个奖励，策略分别在有和没有该奖励验证器信息的情况下重放自身的响应，两个下一词元分布之间的逐词元Jensen-Shannon距离用于衡量每个词元的相关性，并据此重新分配优势。在文本到SQL、多约束指令遵循等任务上……
tldr: 提出MRTPO方法，通过对比有/无验证器信息时的下一词元分布的Jensen-Shannon距离，将每个奖励的优势精准分配到其相关词元上，无需辅助模型或词元级标注即可实现多奖励强化学习中的奖励专属词元级信用分配。
